summary: A Google Fonts minisite (same Kabisa template family as Fraunces) for Arapey, a Bodoni-flavoured variable serif (wght 100–900, opsz 12–128) named after a spa town in northern Uruguay. Red, black and green sections give each control its own small demo (style dropdown + size slider, thin/black toggles, sliding glyph strips, a zoomable grid, a live weather widget), and a hotel-branding collage, floating annotated letters, an opsz explainer with CSS and a with/without-opsz wipe teach the design.

instances.ux: A 'Loading' screen precedes it; the green badge becomes a fixed button that follows the page; scroll prompt
